page.overview:
Who is Yong Park?

Yong Park is a character in the 1995 novel Mortal Kombat. Yong is a former ninja whose ghost would becomes part of Scorpion.

Yong Park had always had time to think when he sat in his small booth by the centuries-old canal. He was not able to read as there was nothing else to do while he raised and lowered the pike and collected tolls from merchants, fishers, and travelers using the waterway. Yong would turned over the fees he collected to the local government in exchange for his modest wage of five yuan a week. Though not an exciting or especially rewarding life, it was exactly what Yong wanted.

Yong had chosen to leave Lin Kuei so that he could have a family. When he was a young ninja, Yong was energetic, trained to think only of honor, and never contemplated dying. Yet, it got change when his age gradually approached thirty, which passed the average age in the field of ninja, where very few people lived to be sixty.

However, at a certain point, Sub-Zero suddenly showed up at the tollbooth where Yong worked, dragging Yong's wife and son, Tsui there so they could watch how Yong was slaughtered and died as Sub-Zero disembowel Yong to spill his blood. Young's family could do nothing but screaming and crying upon watching his intestines and stomach exposed, still alive, as he squirmed and shrieked and died.
